text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1935/6 – TUESDAY, OCTOBER 06, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)
Notice Made Under Section 7

My Number: 3/3/2/93. THE Notice is given herewith that the Government intends to acquire the foregoing lands, which are required for a public affair under the Sub Section (1) of the Section 7 in the Land Acquisition Act.

Description of the lands which, are intended to be acquired: The foregoing allotments of lands in extent of 2.2427 Hectares, from the full extent indicated as in the Lot No. 218-222 and depicted as Zone No. 16 on the Page No. 9 in the Original Field Plan No. 520022 and dated 03.09.2015 made by Survey General in the village of Siyambalagoda, Division of Homagama Divisional Secretary, Colombo District and in the Western Province.

Lot No. 218 Name of Land: Olupattawaovita, Description: Available home garden, king coconut trees 8, Bread Fruits Trees 2 and Areca trees 8; Claimants: Government, Predecessor in Title: A. M.Shanil Fernando, 80, Muhandiram Road, Colombo 03. Extent: 0.0318 Hectares.
Lot No. 219 Name of Land: Olupattawaovita, Description: Paddy Field, Claimants: Government, Predecessor in Title: A. M. Shanil Fernando, 80, Muhandiram Road, Colombo 03. Extent: 2.0089 Hectares.
Lot No. 220 Name of Land: Olupattawaovita, Description: Meadow Claimants: Government, Predecessor in Title:
A. M. Shanil Fernando, 80, Muhandiram Road, Colombo 03. Extent: 0.0089 Hectares.

Lot No. 221 Name of Land: Olupattawaovita, Description: Available meadow, coconut trees 5, and Areca trees 2 Claimants: Government, Predecessor in Title: A. M. Shanil Fernando, 80, Muhandiram Road, Colombo 03. Extent: 0.0197 Hectares.

Lot No. 222 Name of Land: Olupattawaovita, Description: Available meadow, coconut trees 15, and Areca trees 12. Claimants: Government, Predecessor in Title: A. M. Shanil Fernando, 80, Muhandiram Road, Colombo 03. Extent: 0.1734 Hectares.

All those, who claim entitlements, ownerships or other relationships for the aforesaid lands, should meet me by oneself or through authorized persons with their consent letters in Divisional Secretariat of Homagama, at 10.00 a.m. on the 18th Day, Month of November in the Year 2015.

And the nature of their entitlements for that land, a description of facts for demanding claims for the said land, the amount of claim and the way of its calculations should be submitted in writing with two copies before the 11 Day Month of November in the year 2015.
G. S. K. KANNANGARA, Divisional Secretary, Homagama. 05th Day October 2015, Divisional Secretariat, Homagama. 10 - 768
